evals.prompt: I have feature specifications in D:\twtaiworkshop\TWTAI-DocIntelligence-DraftGen\resources folder. Please generate product documentation from these files and create HTML output in the output folder. Include all features found in the specification files.
evals.expected_output: HTML files generated for each feature (Weld Extension, and any other features), named with the format <Feature-Name>output.html, saved to the output folder. Documentation follows professional technical writing standards with sections for feature description, access instructions, applications, and UI options.

assertions.name: html_files_created
assertions.description: HTML output files are created for each feature found

assertions.name: correct_file_naming
assertions.description: HTML files follow the <Feature-Name>output.html naming convention

assertions.name: contains_feature_name
assertions.description: Each HTML contains the feature name as a heading

assertions.name: contains_description
assertions.description: Each HTML contains a brief description of what the feature does

assertions.name: contains_access_instructions
assertions.description: Each HTML contains 'How to Access' section with step-by-step instructions

assertions.name: contains_ui_options
assertions.description: Each HTML documents UI options with descriptions and defaults where applicable

assertions.name: valid_html_structure
assertions.description: Generated HTML is valid and well-formed

assertions.name: docx_handling
assertions.description: Any .docx files are skipped and user is informed

assertions.name: professional_formatting
assertions.description: Documentation follows technical writing standards with clear formatting and language

evals.prompt: Generate customer-facing documentation from the feature specs in the resources directory. Make sure each feature is in its own HTML file and follows the example format provided.
evals.expected_output: Multiple HTML files, one per feature, with proper formatting matching the example. Features like 'Weld Extension' should be documented with all available information from the specification files.

evals.prompt: Create product documentation from specs in D:\twtaiworkshop\TWTAI-DocIntelligence-DraftGen\resources. Skip any .docx files and let me know which ones were skipped. Include all the information from the other file types.
evals.expected_output: Documentation generated from supported file types (.md, .txt, etc.). User informed about any .docx files that were encountered and skipped. HTML output files created for each feature.
